title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
llm_summary: Elon Musk and a host of other tech leaders have signed a petition urging Nvidia to bring its CEO Jensen Huang back after his brief ouster, arguing that his leadership is essential for the company’s continued innovation. The appeal has quickly gathered momentum,
